title: Point to another route
summary: Express.js: Point to another route. Inspect the first response Location header with curl -i.
introduction: A redirect asks the client to visit another URL. GET /start points to /hello; a browser follows it.
learningObjectives: Point to another route with Express.js
Inspect the first response Location header with curl -i

blocks.text: In a practice folder run npm init -y and npm install express@5. Save one example as server.mjs and run node server.mjs. Use the stated URL on http://127.0.0.1:3000; stop with Ctrl+C before another example.

blocks.title: Point to another route

blocks.text: The first handler sends Location: /hello. The following request receives Welcome.
Inspect the first response Location header with curl -i.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: A redirect is a new request, not an internal function call.
